Ekoki kopesa kaka bankombo ya mintindo oyo. Nzete oyo ezali moko na yango te ezwaka kaka oyo ekokani na yango koleka, yango wana tala pourcentage.

Modèle oyo ekoki koyeba, kasi awa ekoki koyekola lisusu te: ekabolamaki uta na Herb Lens te, to ezali ya version ya kala. Ba modèles oyo ekabolami uta na version ya sika ya Herb Lens ekoki kozwa mintindo mpe bafoto ya sika.

Programme oyo eyekoli koyeba makambo oyo ezongaka uta na bafoto mingi ya ndakisa. Med Herb Lens esalelaka ba modèles mpo na kopesa nkombo ya nzete oyo ezali na foto. Modèle eyebaka kaka oyo eteyamaki, mpe ekoki kosala libunga.

Lolenge ya AI oyo etalaka foto mobimba mpe eponaka na liste moko ya kotelema nkombo oyo ekokani na yango koleka, elongo na pourcentage ya elikya na yango. Ekoki kopesa nkombo ya eloko oyo ezali na liste na yango te, kolakisa esika biloko ezali na foto, to kolimbola foto te.

Ndenge nini modèle endimi nkombo moko, uta 0 kino 100%. Ezali makanisi ya modèle yango moko, kasi garantie te: modèle ekoki kondima mingi mpe kosala kaka libunga, mingimingi mpo na banzete oyo eteyamaki te. Biyano oyo ezali na nse ya ndelo ya elikya oyo etiami na Profil ebombami.

Elilingi mobimba eyebaka elilingi mobimba na mbala moko. Pona nzete eyebaka liboso nzete moko na moko na elilingi (koyeba biloko) mpe etiaka yango elembo ya litonga, sima eyebaka kaka nzete wana. Esalisaka ntango banzete mingi emonani.
Bolamu: modèle na yo etongami na nini

Modèle na yo etongami likolo ya modèle ya bilili oyo ebongisami kala, oyo eyebi kala maye, balangi mpe ndenge biloko ezali. Uta na bafoto na yo, eyekolaka kaka litambe ya suka, kokabola mintindo na yo, yango wana bafoto ntuku mwa moke ekoki. Ya solo koleka esalelaka DINOv2 (ya Meta): ya solo mingi koleka, kasi kotanga foto moko na moko ezwaka ntango mingi (pene na eteni ya zomi ya seconde na iPhone ya sika, pene na seconde moko na telefone ya kati), mpe na mbala ya liboso 23 MB ekitaka. Noki esalelaka MobileNet moke (uta na MediaPipe ya Google): noki, ya solo mingi te. Ba modèles oyo esalemaki liboso na Ekokani to Malamu koleka ebombaka MobileNet monene oyo esalaki yango.

Koteya modèle na ndakisa. Opesaka yango bafoto oyo ebongisami na mintindo; mbala na mbala ebongisaka yango moko kino eyekola kokabola yango. Awa nyonso esalemaka na appareil na yo mpe bafoto na yo etindamaka te.
Koleka mbala moko na bafoto nyonso ya koteya. Sima ya mbala moko na moko modèle emekamaka na bafoto ya komeka. Koteya etelemaka soki ekomi malamu lisusu te, to sima ya mbala ya likolo.

Eteni ya bafoto na yo oyo etiami pembeni mpe esalelamaka ata mokolo moko te mpo na koyekola. Sima ya mbala moko na moko modèle emekamaka na yango mpo na komona ndenge ezali kosala na bafoto oyo emonaki te mpe koyeba ntango nini kotelema.
Bosolo na bafoto oyo emonaki te

Eteni ya bafoto ya test, oyo etiamaki pembeni mpe eyekolamaki ata mokolo moko te, oyo modèle oyo esili epesaka nkombo malamu. Ezali elembo ya malamu koleka ya ndenge ekosala na bafoto ya sika, soki ekokani na oyo osalelaki mpo na koteya yango.

Motuya oyo elakisi ndenge biyano ya modèle ezali ya mabe, kotalaka ndenge endimaki. Soki ezali na nse, ezali malamu. Soki libunga na bafoto oyo eyekolaka ezali kaka kokita kasi na bafoto ya komeka ezali komata, modèle ezali kokanga bafoto na yango na motó na esika ya koyekola (overfitting).

Tableau ya bafoto ya test. Molongo moko na moko ezali lolenge oyo foto elakisi solo; likonzi moko na moko lolenge oyo modèle elobaki. Mituya oyo ezali na diagonale ezali biyano ya malamu; mosusu elakisi mintindo nini esangisaka.
Tanga motuya, Bomba ya kala to Teya nyonso lisusu

Tanga motuya etiaka modèle uta na bafoto nyonso: foto ya kati ya lolenge moko na moko, mpe ndenge bafoto ekeseni, oyo mintindo nyonso ekabolaka. Mbala ya koteya ezali te, yango wana ezwaka kaka mwa ntango moke, ebosanaka te, mpe na ba test na biso ezalaki ya solo koleka. Ntango okobakisa mintindo to bafoto sima, Bomba ya kala eteyaka na bafoto ya sika elongo na ndambo ya bafoto ya kala; ezali noki mpe ebosanaka te oyo eyebaki (koyekola kozanga kotelema). Teya nyonso lisusu ebandaka lisusu na ebandeli na bafoto nyonso: malembe koleka, mbala mosusu mwa ya solo koleka.
Bonene ya litambe oyo modèle esalaka mbala nyonso ebongisaka yango moko. Soki ezali monene mingi, epumbwaka awa na wana mpe ekitaka te; soki ezali moke mingi, eyekolaka malembe mingi.
Bafoto boni modèle etalaka liboso ya bobongisi moko na moko. Bituluku ya minene epesaka matambe ya malamu; ya mike ekoki koyekola mingi uta na bafoto moke.
Koteya etelemaka soki bafoto ya komeka ekomi malamu te mbala oyo nyonso, mpe mbala oyo eleki malamu ebombamaka. Yango epekisaka modèle kokanga bafoto na yango na motó.
Kobenda moke oyo ebatelaka mituya ya modèle mike, mpo etalela makambo oyo ezongaka mingi na esika ya makambo ya bafoto moke. Mituya ya likolo ebatelaka mingi na kokanga na motó.
Motuya ya ebandeli mpo na maponi ya kozanga kokana na koteya, lokola bafoto nini etiama pembeni. Mboto moko mpe bafoto moko epesaka modèle moko, yango wana eyano ekoki kozongelama.
Etando mosusu ya biteni kati ya modèle ya moboko mpe eyano, oyo epesaka modèle nzela ya koyekola bokeseni ya mindondo. 0 elakisi moko te: pete, noki mpe mbala mingi ekoki.

Soki mintindo mosusu ezali na bafoto moke mingi, modèle elingaka mingi mosusu. Kokanisa etangaka foto moko na moko ya lolenge oyo ezali mingi te lokola na motuya koleka, mpo lolenge nyonso ezala na bozito ndenge moko.

Format ya fichier oyo esalelamaka mingi mpo na ba modèles ya AI oyo esalaka na ba telefone mpe ba appareils mosusu ya mike. Modèle oyo ebombami boye, elongo na liste ya mintindo na kati, esalaka mpe na ba applications mosusu oyo esalisaka ba modèles TensorFlow Lite, kaka na Med Herb Lens te.
Site ya bato nyonso epai bato ya bolukiluki mpe ba développeurs bakabolaka ba modèles ya AI. Kobimisa kuna epesaka basusu nzela ya koluka, kokitisa mpe kotanga modèle na yo.
Bisika ya bafoto euti na bato oyo bakabolaki yango mpe etalami te, yango wana ekoki kozala ya solo te.

Teya esalaka modèle na yo moko ya AI oyo ekabolaka biloko oyo oponi, eyekoli uta na bafoto na yo moko. Ezali kaka mpo na banzete te: esalaka na esika nyonso epai biloko ekoki kokabolama na bafoto, lokola bilanga (ndakisa kokabola ba tomate oyo babuki na bolamu na yango), zamba, bobateli ya bomoi (koyeba banyama mabe, bokono to matiti mabe) to koteya mpe bolukiluki na monganga. Koteya esalemaka na appareil oyo.\n\nSikoyo esalaka kaka ba modèles ya bokaboli ya bilili: modèle oyo elobaka foto elakisi lolenge nini kati na oyo na yo (mintindo, ba classes, bizaleli). Ba modèles oyo oteyaka ezali mpo na koyekola mpe bolukiluki: kotia elikya kaka na yango te mpo na mikano oyo esengeli moto ya mayele, lokola koyeba bokono to soki bilei ezali malamu.
Pesa modèle nkombo, bakisa lolenge moko na moko elongo na bafoto na yango, teya yango, sima meka yango na kamera.

Dear friends,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Trien Phat Tran, and I am currently pursuing my PhD in Computer Science at the University of New England (Australia), under the guidance of Dr. Fareed Ud Din, Professor Ljiljana Brankovic, Professor Cesar Sanin, and Associate Professor Susan Hester.

I am writing to invite you to participate in an important phase of my PhD research. My study focuses on developing a mobile application for identifying Vietnamese medicinal plants using deep learning and crowdsourced data. Our goal is to create a user-friendly app that leverages community-contributed data to train and optimize deep learning models, ensuring accurate and safe identification of medicinal plants.

To ensure the success of this project, I am conducting an online survey to gather insights and feedback from individuals with knowledge and experience in this field. Your participation would be invaluable in helping us better understand the needs and expectations of users for this application.

The survey includes questions about:
• User interface and experience of the mobile application.
• Suggest new features that could benefit your work or field of expertise.
• Effectiveness and clarity of the plant identification process.
• Methods for crowd-sourcing data and user engagement strategies.

The survey will take approximately 10-15 minutes to complete. We greatly appreciate your time and contribution to this research. Your feedback will play a crucial role in refining and enhancing the quality of the application.

Please tap Take the survey below to begin.

If you have any questions or require further information, please do not hesitate to contact me at ttran72@myune.edu.au. I look forward to receiving your response and sincerely thank you for your support.

Best Regards,

Trien Phat Tran
PhD Candidate - Computer Science
University of New England
